Subject: Request: baseline per-1M token rates (input/output) + supported model list

Hi Vanessa,

Quick intro — I’m Emma, Head of Platform at Lighthouse AI. We’re evaluating hosted inference providers for a feature launch H2. We’re primarily interested in Redwood’s Hosted API. Could you share your standard per-1M token pricing broken out by input vs output, and a current list of hosted models (small/medium/large tiers) with any model-specific notes (streaming, recommended latencies)?

A few context points to make the ask practical:
- Expected baseline usage: ~5M tokens/month during first 3 months, scaling to ~20M after product-market fit.
- Typical calls are short generation (prompt ~150 tokens, completion ~250 tokens) and some chat flows.
- We care about predictable IO pricing for forecasting — also curious about any commit discounts for 5M or 20M monthly volumes and minimum terms.

Could you also attach a simple ratecard and a CSV of the hosted model catalog (including whether a model supports streaming and any notes about latency tiers)? If you need rough token distribution details from us I can share.

Thanks — could you get back with a baseline by EOD tomorrow? We’re trying to compile initial vendor economics.

Best,
Emma Carroll
Head of Platform | Lighthouse AI

Hi Emma — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the context. Attaching a short ratecard and the current hosted model catalog CSV (see attachments). Below is a concise baseline you can use for planning — this is our standard Hosted IO pricing (no commit):

Baseline Hosted IO (per 1M tokens) — April 2027
- Small models (e.g., redwood-lite-3B): input $0.50 | output $0.75
- Medium models (e.g., redwood-medium-13B): input $1.20 | output $1.80
- Large models (e.g., redwood-large-70B): input $3.00 | output $4.25

Notes:
- Rates are per 1M tokens, billed separately for input vs output.
- Streaming: supported for medium+ models; small models support short-streaming (chunked text).
- Latency: typical p95 for small/medium is 40–120ms token-generation time; large models depend on sequence length.

Preliminary commit discounts (hosted):
- 5M tokens/month commit: 12% off baseline
- 20M tokens/month commit: 20% off baseline
- >50M/month: custom pricing (volume + term)

If you expect the 5M to be primarily short completions (roughly 35% input / 65% output by token count) that will inform the modeled spend — feel free to share a sample distribution and we’ll run a quick estimate.

Attachments included: redwood-hosted-ratecard-2027Q2.pdf, redwood-model-catalog-202704.csv

Next steps: want to schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the catalog and answer any technical constraints (latency SLOs, region pinning, tokenization differences)? If you’re looking for a firm quote we can prepare a preliminary 12-month commitment proposal for 5M/month and include a sample contract/DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz

Hi Emma — looping in Marissa (Sales Manager) for pricing confirmation and a short-term proposal.

Vanessa sent a good baseline; to be explicit about a 5M/month commercial offer:
- Proposed commercial: 12% off the baseline hosted IO rates for a 12-month commitment at 5M tokens/month. Estimated monthly spend (example split 35% input / 65% output):
  - Using medium models as example (baseline input $1.20 / output $1.80):
  - Monthly tokens: 5,000,000 -> input 1,750,000 tokens, output 3,250,000 tokens
  - Gross (no discount): (1.75 * $1.20) + (3.25 * $1.80) per 1M token = $2.10 + $5.85 = $7.95 per 1M combined average -> monthly gross ~ $39.75
  - Apply 12% commit discount -> est. monthly charge ~ $34.98 (rounded)

We can formalize this into a short preliminary quote and include standard Hosted SLA (99.9% uptime for the control plane; model serving availability depends on region & model family). If Lighthouse needs stronger SLOs or data residency, we can outline Dedicated or Private options (those are separate SKUs).

I’ve created a preliminary quote PDF (prelim-quote-LighthouseAI-5M.pdf) and added a DocuSign link for the quote/standard terms if you want to move quickly.

If the 5M is a pilot and you’d prefer month-to-month, we can also offer a one-month trial at 10% off baseline to help validate production usage before committing.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call to finalize.

—Marissa Cole
